scope: Documented explicit public Rust operations including expanded macros and public aliases; native export-completeness acceptance remains INT-PY-01. No source-only or signature-only runtime claim.

native_metadata_origin.scope: Actual existing downstream 0.4.0 native metadata in the prior installed wheel; this is signature discovery only, not new namespace or current-wheel execution.

contracts.ownership.borrowed: Rust borrows input/self for the declared lifetime. Returned references remain tied to the owner; native counterparts return owned copies. No zero-copy Python claim.
contracts.ownership.mutable: Exclusive mutable Rust session; accepted values are owned snapshots. Invalid replacement preserves prior accepted state; configuration does not start work.
contracts.ownership.owned: Value arguments move/copy into an owned Rust result as declared. Native constructors use checked conversion and owned Rust values.
contracts.units.none: No physical quantity; identities, enum choices, status and booleans are dimensionless.
contracts.units.bytes: Original octets, byte offsets and finite byte/element counts; no physical inference.
contracts.units.configuration: Explicit physical FFT indices; frequencies/bandwidth in Hz or named spacing_khz; CP/RP/window lengths in samples; capture epochs in seconds and activation offsets in symbols remain separate.
contracts.units.measurement: RxMER in dB or explicitly named linear residual power; complex Pre-Eq is dimensionless corrective C. Preserve physical bins, source epochs and explicit symbol offsets.
contracts.units.report: Counts/BER are dimensionless; elapsed runtime is milliseconds; rates and spectrum retain their named units/reference planes. Unavailable values remain optional/null.
contracts.units.seconds: Unix epoch seconds or explicitly documented tolerance seconds.
contracts.errors.ds: ApiResult retains existing ApiError/ErrorCode and optional original SimulationError. Python uses structured exceptions; checked conversion errors stay native language errors.
contracts.errors.us: ApiResult retains structured capture/domain/serialization causes and offsets. category() returns shared ErrorCode; legacy code() strings remain available. New native conversion is pending INT-PY-01.
contracts.errors.domain: Typed core PhyResult preserves original domain fields; unsupported modes are explicit and no substitute algorithm is selected.
contracts.errors.export: Structured ExportError preserves export_code, capture/subcarrier context, finite-range policy and I/O/limit failures. Native conversion retains these details in ApiError attributes.
contracts.errors.serde: Typed Serde deserializer failure for malformed or oversized sequences; no separate native operation.
contracts.units.response: Dimensionless complex linear voltage response H; retain the downstream channel reference plane.
contracts.units.channel: Complex voltage taps H are dimensionless; noise variance is normalized power, delays are samples, phase is radians and CFO is Hz.
contracts.units.receiver: Normalized noise variance/equalizer power floor, decoder iteration count and explicit carrier-gap count.
contracts.units.signal: Dimensionless normalized complex signal amplitude; squared magnitude is normalized power.
contracts.errors.none: No recoverable Result failure in this declaration; existing validated-owner and lifetime preconditions remain binding.
contracts.lifecycle.inspect: Idle read-only construction, validation or inspection. No source/RNG/worker is started; observing accepted metadata cannot rerun science.
contracts.lifecycle.configure: Idle atomic admission/replacement. Entire schedule and work budgets validate before accepted state changes or source consumption.
contracts.lifecycle.run: Explicit bounded execution with owned complete/partial reports. Preserve actual FEC/source outcomes and accepted provenance. Rust exclusive borrowing serializes session mutation; native Busy/GIL acceptance is separate.
contracts.lifecycle.control: Thread-safe cooperative stop; clones share one-way cancellation. Upstream rich controls retain directional pause/progress/Busy state and safe boundaries.
contracts.compatibility.ds: Exact current/legacy downstream type re-export. Original imports, signatures, defaults, errors and scientific behavior remain supported; native directional imports await INT-PY-01.
contracts.compatibility.us: Additive independent upstream Rust operation. Recognized configuration, executable support and native wrapper availability remain distinct.
contracts.compatibility.common: Shared nominal contract with legacy downstream re-export; directional reports/configuration/limits remain separate.
contracts.evidence.ds: namespace-evidence.json and namespace-test-results.json: all 71 downstream exported types/aliases retain exact old/new identity; 26 high-level and 6 lifecycle regressions pass. This is preservation evidence, not independent new coverage for every getter branch.
contracts.evidence.us: namespace-test-results.json plus ../ofdma/implementation-evidence.json: actual bounded Rust upstream runs and 83 engine cases pass. Planned native bindings are not executed by these records.
contracts.evidence.pnm: ../pnm-measurement-inputs/implementation-evidence.json: decoder/association cases and captured-plan loops pass inside MERLIN; native exposure remains separate.
contracts.evidence.common: namespace-test-results.json: literal category spelling/order, shared clone/atomic queries, exact type identity and paused common cancellation cases pass.
contracts.status.ds: Implemented Rust and existing root Python; Rust namespace unit validated. New Python namespace/wheel and final regression acceptance pending.
contracts.status.us: Implemented and locally validated Rust scope; native signatures are planned until INT-PY-01 unless explicitly language-only.
contracts.status.common: Implemented and locally validated Rust shared contract; Python common namespace/added query acceptance pending.
